**Question:** If k + 1, 3k and 4k + 2 be any three consecutive terms of an AP, find the value of k.

**Answer:**
k + 1 , 3k and 4k + 2 are three consecutive terms of an AP. ∴ (3k) - (k + 1) = (4k + 2) - (3k) (∵ ak+1 − ak is constant.) ∴ 2k - 1 = k + 2 ∴k=3
